stage.name: Heroes of Nanwu
stage.description:
Taking first place is only the prelude to this gathering of the jianghu. Why do you think the Nanwu styles boast so many martial schools and escort agencies?
Use Ranged Operators to fight the foe you picked; Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

arc_screenguard.name: Arc Screenguard
arc_screenguard.flavourText: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. However, the unresolved instability of the material makes them better suited for short, high-pressure skirmishes than drawn-out battles.
abilities: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

parade_snack_seller.name: Parade Snack Seller
parade_snack_seller.flavourText: A snack seller—part of a swarm trailing the parade—his cart filled to the brim with treats. However, they're not the only thing in stock.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage; loses damage reduction during Carnevale
Periodically summons a <Parade Snack Cart>

reckless_grenadier.name: Reckless Grenadier
reckless_grenadier.flavourText: A specialized combatant who does not carry conventional weapons. Though well-paid and exempted from standard military training, nobody envies them.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time while unblocked, fires an explosive in each cardinal direction; afterwards, gains increased Movement Speed and reduced Weight

risk_surviving_sailor.name: Risk-surviving Sailor
risk_surviving_sailor.flavourText: Sailing in the Salt Flat is a hazardous affair to begin with, but some sailors seek even greater thrills, such as hanging from a flying fin, or firing themselves from saltheap cannons. Those who survive tend to go to even more extreme lengths to satisfy their thirst for danger.
abilities: Movement Speed increases briefly when crossing a Rope Bridge or launched by a <Saltheap Cannon>

shadow_scholar.name: Shadow Scholar
shadow_scholar.flavourText: A character often seen in Yanese shadow plays, prone to strange encounters in those plays. This Shadowgeist has seen these scenes play out so many times that it believes them to be real, and even warning of the talismans is not enough to dissuade it.
abilities: When HP drops below a certain level, absorbs a nearby <Talisman> and recovers HP

cradle.name: 'Cradle'
cradle.flavourText: Fae disguising itself as a fowlbeast nest. A cradle, just the right temperature... and 'hatchlings' breaking from their shells?
abilities: Grows when outside your units' Attack Range, increasing its ATK and Max HP

bottle_swordsman.name: Bottle Swordsman
bottle_swordsman.flavourText: Once a wandering physician's medicine bottle, it provided healing to many warriors. When it became a geist, it was moved by a talisman and put the talisman in its bottle, embarking on a journey of chivalry.
abilities: Starts with 3 <Talismans>; attacks attach a <Talisman> to the target when carrying a <Talisman>

entusiasta_lead_dancer.name: Entusiasta Lead Dancer
entusiasta_lead_dancer.flavourText: The lead dancer from a troupe invited by big companies to liven up Carnevale. Her skirt flickers like flame, warming the crowd and setting the streets ablaze—literally!
abilities: Invisible
Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration, Attack Range increases when Invisibility is lost
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

fashion_street_robust_heavy.name: Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy'
fashion_street_robust_heavy.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the sports field. It'll be really happy if you throw its 'treasure' back at it. Wait, no! It seem to be holding discuses this time!
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

mirror_tianshi.name: Mirror Tianshi
mirror_tianshi.flavourText: A well-polished mirror that believes it sees everything clearly. When it became a Geist, it was not content with just seeing things, but could not stop itself from giving unsolicited advice, just like the old scholars in the Tianshi Bureau.
abilities: Picks a target from very long range, dealing Arts damage and sending a <Talisman>

talisman.name: Talisman
talisman.flavourText: Paper talisman seen throughout the Garden of Grotesqueries, with various messages written on them: Timetables, notes, tips, prohibitions... Endowed with meaning by the hand of man, it stubbornly refuses to leave anyone that it sticks to.
abilities: Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks
When attached to a target, deals Arts damage every second and prevents them from using skills

armor_of_the_empire.name: 'Armor of the Empire'
armor_of_the_empire.flavourText: Royal Guards who swore an oath of eternal loyalty to Victoria. In the King's memories, their steel bodies lined up to form mountains, and white steam covered the sky above.
abilities: Locks onto an allied unit with the current highest HP, dealing Physical damage multiple times to it and the nearby unit with the current highest HP
Can perform long-ranged attacks
After several attacks, charges up for an attack that deals heavy damage 3 times

bejeweled_slab_guardian.name: 'Bejeweled Slab Guardian'
bejeweled_slab_guardian.flavourText: Strange entities sighted amongst the jewel constructs. The bejeweled stone slabs that they carry shine brightly in the night streets, like glowing great swords.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Starts with low DEF and RES, but permanently gains DEF when taking Physical damage and RES when taking Arts damage, up to a maximum.

merrymaker_express.name: 'Merrymaker Express'
merrymaker_express.flavourText: A large truck spraying beer over the masses from within the parade at the behest of corporations. The crowd goes wild, and order slowly collapses. Now it's a real party.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage; loses damage reduction during Carnevale
After charging for some time, deals Physical damage to a target and all surrounding allied units, and temporarily lowers maximum Block; this attack can weaken flames

traffic_tower_prototype.name: 'Traffic Tower' Prototype
traffic_tower_prototype.flavourText: A robot primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski, the crystallization of cutting-edge advances in every field. If they could lower the cost of production to make it feasible for mass-production, perhaps it could even change the nature of warfare.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
DEF and RES is reduced whenever damage is taken
When destroyed, ejects a <'Traffic Officer Captain'> and self-destructs, dealing physical damage to nearby units

arts_master_a2.name: Arts Master A2
arts_master_a2.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone that had some of its Flight Support modules swapped out, trading speed for a more powerful Arts Weapon module. Capable of using long-range Arts attacks. Proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.
abilities: Flying unit.

bel_canto_boatswain.name: Bel Canto Boatswain
bel_canto_boatswain.flavourText: The boatswain's saltfin has caught the sailors' attention, but it does not stop bellowing when the boatswain wants it to. Forced to yell above the saltfin's cacophony, the boatswain has developed a bel canto voice so beautiful that it may impress the salt flat itself.
abilities: While on the battlefield, <Risk-surviving Sailor> attacks also inflict Corrosion; Periodically summons 2 <Risk-surviving Sailors>
ATK increases when blocked

burning_wick.name: Burning Wick
burning_wick.flavourText: Very passionate fae, burning with a even greater desire to consume all uninvited visitors, or consume itself until the last spark becomes a dim ember.
abilities: Attacks inflict additional Burn
ATK continuously increases before its first attack, and the first attack deals a large amount of Arts damage and Burn to the target and surrounding units

chalice_of_regret.name: Chalice of Regret
chalice_of_regret.flavourText: Soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with regret unfathomable. The past, tormenting yet unchangeable, is the cruelest cut.
abilities: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

drifting_aroma.name: Drifting Aroma
drifting_aroma.flavourText: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, add some burdenbeast tallow, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.
abilities: Continuously inflicts Arts damage and Burn to its surroundings
Immune to Slow

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

fashion_street_hyperactive_aviator.name: Fashion Street 'Hyperactive Aviator'
fashion_street_hyperactive_aviator.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the aviation shop. It can fly, but it's not very good at it. However, it's learned to float around in a group, filling the sky with soft clouds and interrupting the people's leisurely sunbathing.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Can stack with a Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy' and is capable of long-range attacks after combining

father_agenir.name: Father Agenir
father_agenir.flavourText: Agenir, Sankta priest, one of the founders of Siracusa's ironclad order. Do not hesitate–though he does not necessarily stand opposed to you, his guns speak first. By the way, his favorite eye mask was made in Lungmen.
abilities: Gradually increases Blood Debt
Attacks have global range when Asset Liquidation is active
Attacks using Ammo decrease the target's DEF. Ammo capacity: 10

fortuna_fallen_angel.name: Fortuna, Fallen Angel
fortuna_fallen_angel.flavourText: A fallen Sankta girl, the innocent and ignorant Fortuna. With her dimmed halo and black horns, paradise has closed its doors on her. What has actually changed, and what has not?
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal a large amount of Physical damage. Ammo capacity: 6
Has a chance to miss ranged attacks

frost.name: Frost
frost.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone equipped with heavy armor to make it harder to destroy. Its prototype was designed by a graphics engine studio. They are equipped with a special device that allows them to drastically reduce the temperature around them, greatly decreasing the attack speed of nearby Operators.
abilities: Flying unit.
All friendly units within range have reduced ASPD

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

inkwave.name: Inkwave
inkwave.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. It is always difficult to put brush to paper, and though the paperweight was once calm and patient, it is now anxious and restless.
abilities: Spawns 15 <Wooden Paperweights> when defeated

introspection.name: Introspection
introspection.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder. A Waregeist of this type can show its opponent their inner secrets, and is more likely to anger its opponents than other Waregeists.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by allied units
Spawns 1 <Bronze Mirror> when defeated

magnificence.name: Magnificence
magnificence.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Its tiny glimmer serves as a beacon casting light upon the dark night. A Waregeist of this type not only blesses its peers with its radiance, but is also particularly destructive.
abilities: Periodically grants temporary Invisibility to surrounding enemy units
Spawns 1 <Iron Lampstand> when defeated

mio_the_eager_examinant.name: Mio, the Eager Examinant
mio_the_eager_examinant.flavourText: Friend? Foe? Mio doesn't care. Mio does what it must.
abilities: Attacks deal Arts splash damage in a cross.
ATK and HP increase with the number of Crystals on the field, up to a maximum.

parading_jazz_musician.name: Parading Jazz Musician
parading_jazz_musician.flavourText: A musician in festive garb who's part of the parade. He's gotten pretty good with his instrument, and he knows when best to get the crowd going.
abilities: Invisible, normally does not attack, but counters when losing Invisibility
Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

prosperity.name: Prosperity
prosperity.flavourText: Abomination born of the people's longing for a better life. Approach it carelessly, and gold coins will come at you in a way that you did not bargain for.
abilities: Spits gold coins to deal heavy damage at long range; Uses only melee attacks when out of coins
Can absorb nearby <Vapidity> or <Sapidity> to regain 1 gold coin

pseudomut.name: Pseudomut
pseudomut.flavourText: Similar in appearance to a Feranmut, it looks like an ancient 'God', but it is no more than a mere beast. It has become extinct in modern times, for its greed never diminished, despite no longer having the reputation of the Feranmuts to draw from.
abilities: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker and gains Low-Altitude Hovering
Returns devoured Operator when defeated

sarkaz_altar_nourisher.name: Sarkaz Altar Nourisher
sarkaz_altar_nourisher.flavourText: Veteran engineer casters of the Nachzehrer legion whose deaths nourish the altars they carry, like leaves upon the barren soil. Their deaths bring forth the promise of suffering.
abilities: Unblockable and has reduced movement speed when taking damage.
Picks up nearby Beacons if it is not carrying a Beacon, and drops them on death.

sharpedge.name: Sharpedge
sharpedge.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The weaponry yet again dreams of the past. A Waregeist of this type rouses its old memories as though it is taking to the battlefield again. Its strength is doubled as it and its peers rally each other.
abilities: Consumes Broken Blades to gain increased ATK
When defeated, each unconsumed Broken Blade will spawn a <Iron Spearhead> (minimum 1)

terrible_chef.name: Terrible Chef
terrible_chef.flavourText: More butcher than cook, the fleet's chefs are more adept at dismembering carcasses than making the aftermath fit for human consumption. No sailor who has seen one dismember a saltfin has the guts to complain about their cooking.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Nearby enemies and <Saltheap Cannons> take far less Physical/Arts damage from sources in the direction of the shield

theater_golem.name: Theater Golem
theater_golem.flavourText: A gigantic golem maintained by the Crimson Troupe's prop department, they are normally used to move bulky items. They are massive and difficult to block.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
Attacks deal Splash damage to allied units in a small area around self

transport_vessel.name: Transport Vessel
transport_vessel.flavourText: A general-use aircraft designed by the Industry Development Association for transporting goods. Some members suggest that having a pilot atop might deter ruffians from shooting it down, fearing the risk of murder.
abilities: Attacks hit 3 times
Deals a large amount of Physical damage to all units in a fixed range when defeated and drops random gear

yeti_icecleaver_leader.name: Yeti Icecleaver Leader
yeti_icecleaver_leader.flavourText: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Experienced executioners on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, and their nickname, 'Ice Cleaver,' references their devastating blows that seem strong enough to split glaciers.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

frost_buck.name: 'Frost Buck'
frost_buck.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Frost Buck'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as scary as the 'Demons'.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets
When <'Snow Doe'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

snow_doe.name: 'Snow Doe'
snow_doe.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Snow Doe'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as twisted as the 'Frozen Monstrosity'.
abilities: Attacks inflict Cold
When <'Frost Buck'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

wandering_puppet.name: Wandering Puppet
wandering_puppet.flavourText: A musical puppet maintained by the Crimson Troupe's prop department. All who have heard its bewitching melodies have turned as one towards the Crimson Troupe, and were never seen again.
abilities: When not blocked, continuously deals Arts damage to all allied units
